tools.name: screen_exclusion
tools.description: Screens one person or business name against a mirrored copy of the HHS-OIG List of Excluded Individuals/Entities (LEIE), the list of people and businesses excluded from Medicare, Medicaid and other federal health care programs. tools.name: screen_exclusions
tools.description: Screens up to 25 person or business names in one call against the same LEIE mirror as screen_exclusion and returns only the best possible match per name (or no match at the threshold) in compact form, with a summary count. tools.name: check_npi
tools.description: Validates a 10-digit National Provider Identifier (check digit) and looks it up in the NPI field of the LEIE mirror. Returns the excluded record(s) that carry it, or a not-on-list result. Most LEIE records have no NPI, so a not-on-list result does not show that a provider is not excluded.

tools.name: exclusion_list_status
tools.description: Returns the version of the mirrored LEIE: OIG's last update date and the month the data runs through, the source file's timestamp, size and hash, record counts (individuals, entities, with NPI), the latest monthly supplement, and when the mirror was last built and last checked for updates.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "screen_exclusion" references sensitive artifacts (credentials). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
